name: Investment of the Chain Master
desc: Requires Pact of the Chain. Your familiar gains a Fly or Swim Speed of 40 feet; as a Bonus Action you can command it to take the Attack action; its Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage can be Necrotic or Radiant instead; its saving throws use your spell save DC; when it takes damage you can take a Reaction to give it Resistance to that damage.

effects.note: Familiar: Fly/Swim 40 ft, attacks on your Bonus Action, uses your spell save DC
